_tokenSource: https://api.robinhood.com/rhj/assets (Robinhood Chain official asset registry API) -- canonical Stock Token ERC-20 addresses.
_chainlinkFeedSource: Classic feeds: https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/price-feeds/addresses?network=robinhood . Data Streams: same docs.chain.link dataset (generic tokenized-equity streams) + https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/data-streams/ for the Robinhood Chain Verifier Proxy address + https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/onchain-verification for the verify() contract flow + https://docs.chain.link/data-streams/sign-up for API access/pricing.
_note: "Top 100 most popular" is a manual curation by real-world recognizability (mega-caps, well-known large caps, popular retail/meme names, space/defense, quantum/nuclear speculative favorites, AI/cloud software, semis), nudged toward tickers that already have a live Chainlink price feed (see _chainlinkFeedNote) where two picks were close calls -- Robinhood's API exposes no trading-volume/popularity signal, and ranking off a public DEX aggregator (tried DexScreener) turned out to be unsafe: unrelated pools using colliding ticker symbols (fake NVDA/TSLA pools, etc.) show up mixed in with the genuine Robinhood tokens. Reorder/replace freely -- the full 194-token registry is included as top100 + remaining94.
_chainlinkFeedNote: FULL PICTURE as of 2026-09-05, checked per-asset for all 194 Robinhood Stock Tokens: only 43 of 194 have ANY Chainlink price signal at all -- 32 have the Robinhood-branded classic Data Feeds push proxy (chainlinkFeed.product==="DataFeeds": free to read on-chain, already bakes in the ERC-8056 corporate-action multiplier, exactly what OracleLib/RBDXVault is built to consume today), 11 more have ONLY a generic Data Streams equity-price feed (chainlinkFeed.product==="DataStreams": no Robinhood branding, no multiplier baked in, requires a paid subscription + off-chain report fetch + an on-chain verify() call + a contract/frontend architecture change -- see integrationNote on each such row), and the remaining 151 have NEITHER -- not oracle-ready by either product yet. chainlinkFeed is null for those. RECOMMENDATION: ship the 32 free DataFeeds-covered tickers as the v1 mainnet asset universe (matches current contract design exactly, zero extra infra/cost); treat the 11 DataStreams-only tickers as a deliberate, paid fast-follow only if wanted (needs a backend, since the static GH-Pages frontend cannot hold Data Streams API secrets); treat the other 151 as blocked on Chainlink adding coverage, not on anything this project controls.

chainlinkFeed.integrationNote: Generic Chainlink equity-price stream, not Robinhood-branded -- does NOT bake in the ERC-8056 corporate-action multiplier the way the DataFeeds product does, so consuming this correctly means separately reading/applying currentMultiplier (see api.robinhood.com/rhj/assets) or an on-chain equivalent. Needs: (1) a paid Chainlink Data Streams subscription (self-serve at app.chain.link, from $150/mo per feed, HMAC-authenticated REST/WebSocket API) to fetch the signed report off-chain before each use: (2) passing that report as calldata into IVerifierProxy.verify() on Robinhood Chain (address above) to get a verified ReportV3 (feedId, price int192, timestamps) -- no LINK/native fee needed for verify() itself, billing is subscription-based; (3) a contract-side change since OracleLib currently expects a push feed with latestRoundData(), not a per-call report payload -- mint()/redeem() would need to accept the report bytes as an argument; (4) since the report must be fetched via an authenticated off-chain API call, the current pure-static GH-Pages frontend cannot do this safely client-side (would leak the API secret) -- a small backend/relayer becomes necessary just for these assets.
